_README: Stage 1 roster spec, dictated by Mike 0808i. THIS IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what each unit is and how it behaves. Do not infer behaviour from a type name.

art_rules.purple_halo: convert every purple halo to a BLACK EDGE — never delete the halo, convert it
art_rules.black_edge: every unit sprite gets a black edge
art_rules.white_flash: every unit gets a usable white-flash variant for hit feedback
art_rules.no_propellers: NO enemy may have propellers. The ONLY propellered unit in the game is the helicopter boss. Units 10 and 11 are therefore OUT.
art_rules.palette_swaps: black-camo palette swaps needed for the jets, and for the boats and tanks
art_rules.unit12_fix: ⚠ unit 12's sprite is clipped — its wing is sitting in unit 11's frame on the source sheet. Fix before registering.
art_rules.missiles_unswapped: ⚠ DO NOT palette-swap the missile graphics. Mike: 'dont swap the missile graphics thoiugh.' On a black-camo variant the hull darkens but the ordnance keeps its authored colour — a red missile stays red, because that is what makes it readable as a threat.

4.name: s1_truck_missile
4.note: wheeled — the wheels should look like they move within their own pixels

5.name: s1_boat_gun
5.note: rapid fire at HALF the player's rate, in ~3 second bursts. Pellets travel like real bullets out of the turret — they do NOT float or gravitate.

6.reason: not named in Mike's spec — he listed the tanks 1-4, boats 5 and 8, the jets, the barrels and the mine

7.reason: not named in Mike's spec — same

8.name: s1_boat_patrol
8.note: moves, pauses, IDLES ~1.5s, then a huge missile blast that knocks itself back a few pixels with shake. The missile does NOT home — it travels like a medium-speed rocket.

10.reason: propellers — only the helicopter boss may have them

11.reason: propellers (tilt-rotor) — only the helicopter boss may have them

12.name: s1_jet_bomber
12.note: ⚠ CLIPPED on the source sheet: its wing is in unit 11's frame. Repair first.

14.name: s1_barrel_fire
14.note: use THIS one on the jungle level, at the coastline, with tanks nearby

16.name: s1_mine_water
16.note: placed in level 1's WATER sections as a hazard, with the level-1 alert. Does NOT scroll — holds its position in the water. Can destroy the player's ship and blows up.

behaviour.boats: MOVE, do not scroll. Free in all 8 directions. They only ATTACK when the player is within their '6' — their facing arc. Placed between the mines, or in open water clear of the mountains and grass.
behaviour.tanks: Same attack styles as the boats, but NOT free movement. Forward and backward only. To reverse they must BRAKE, adjust, then move back. To go sideways they must perform a real reversing turn like a vehicle. Focus on forward/backward.
behaviour.jets: travel at MEDIUM speed toward the player, entering from the top or from the sides.
behaviour.no_mini_vehicles: there are no more mini vehicles
